products.name: Quick QR Scanner
products.tagline: Fast, simple QR and barcode scanning — processed on your device.
products.intro: Scan QR codes and common 1D barcodes with your camera, or open an image from your gallery. Results are shown clearly, and your scan history stays on your device.
features: Scan QR codes and 1D barcodes including EAN-13, EAN-8, UPC-A, UPC-E, Code 128, Code 39, Code 93 and ITF
Also reads PDF417, Aztec and Data Matrix formats
Scan with the camera or pick an existing image from your gallery
Optional automatic opening of scanned URLs
Scan history you can review, prune or clear at any time
Light, dark and system theme options; vibration and sound controls

faq.q: Does Quick QR Scanner require an account?
faq.a: No. The app works without signing in — its listing states that no account is required.

faq.q: Where is my scan history stored?
faq.a: On your device. You can delete individual records or clear the whole history in the app.

faq.q: Which barcode formats are supported?
faq.a: QR codes, plus EAN-13, EAN-8, UPC-A, UPC-E, Code 128, Code 39, Code 93, ITF, PDF417, Aztec and Data Matrix.

products.name: Scan Tools
products.tagline: Scan, capture, sign, OCR, QR and PDF — everyday document tools in one app.
products.intro: Scan Tools puts the everyday document jobs in one place: clean document scans, high-resolution photo capture, signatures, text extraction, QR scanning and PDF conversion, with your files kept together.
features: Document scanner that produces clean, easy-to-read digital copies
High-resolution photo capture for documents, notes and receipts
Sign documents and images digitally
Extract printed text from images with OCR
Scan QR codes and open the information they contain
Convert images into PDF files, and browse saved PDFs and photos in one library

faq.q: Is this the app formerly called Scan2Drive?
faq.a: Yes. The app is listed on Google Play as Scan Tools; the package name is unchanged (com.llcailabs.scan2drive), so existing installs update normally.

faq.q: Can I request deletion of my data?
faq.a: Yes — see the data deletion page for the supported request process.

faq.q: What does OCR do here?
faq.a: It extracts printed text from images so you can reuse notes, receipts and document text instead of retyping it.

products.name: My Days
products.tagline: Birthdays, countdowns, family ages and date maths in one app.
products.intro: My Days keeps track of the dates that matter: your age and next birthday, the days you are counting down to, family birthdays, holiday calendars and date differences.
features: Exact age from your date of birth, in years and days
Next-birthday countdown and a saved birthday for quick access
Important days — birthdays, anniversaries, trips, exams, holidays and custom events — with countdowns
Family list with birthdays, ages, countdowns and notes
Calendar view with ICS calendar URL import and public holiday calendars
Date calculator for the difference between two dates

faq.q: Is this the app formerly called Age Calculator?
faq.a: Yes. It is listed on Google Play as My Days; the package name is unchanged (com.llcailabs.agecalculator), so existing installs update normally.

faq.q: Does My Days show advertising?
faq.a: The app's own privacy policy documents its advertising behaviour. Advertising is off by default and can be enabled in Settings; see the privacy policy for the current details.

faq.q: Where are the dates I enter stored?
faq.a: On your device. See the privacy policy for what is stored and how to remove it.

products.name: uConverter
products.tagline: Convert units, calculate BMI, and get quick everyday measurements.
products.intro: A small, reliable converter for the measurements you actually need, with a built-in BMI calculator. Calculations run on your device.
features: Length: metres, kilometres, centimetres, feet, inches and more
Weight: kilograms, grams, pounds and other common units
Area: square metres, square feet and more
Temperature: Celsius, Fahrenheit and other scales
Data storage units and reference currency conversion
BMI calculator from height and weight; works offline for calculations

faq.q: Are the currency rates live?
faq.a: No. Currency conversion is a reference aid for information only and may not reflect live market rates.

faq.q: Is the BMI result medical advice?
faq.a: No. BMI is provided for general informational and wellness purposes only, not as medical advice.

faq.q: Does it work offline?
faq.a: Yes — the calculations run offline on your device.

products.name: SnapLedger
products.tagline: Scan receipts and track expenses — on your device.
products.intro: Photograph a receipt, let SnapLedger pick out the useful details, review them, and save the expense. Core tracking works offline and needs no account.
features: On-device text recognition pulls merchant, date, total, category and payment method from a receipt
You review and edit the extracted fields before anything is saved
Receipt images are stored locally on your device
Spending overview by total, recent expenses, category, merchant and month
Core expense tracking works offline
No account required

faq.q: Does SnapLedger need an internet connection?
faq.a: Core expense tracking is designed to work offline. Receipt images stay on your device.

faq.q: Can I correct a receipt that was read wrong?
faq.a: Yes. Extracted fields are shown for review and can be edited before you save the expense.

faq.q: How do I delete my data?
faq.a: Use the deletion page linked below, or the in-app options described in the privacy policy.

products.name: mPOS — Mobile Point of Sale
products.tagline: Offline-first point of sale for small shops, stalls and mobile sellers.
products.intro: Run products, stock, checkout and receipts from an Android device. Everyday POS operations work without an account or an internet connection.
features: Products with names, prices, categories, SKUs, stock quantities and low-stock thresholds
Fast checkout: tap products into a cart, adjust quantities and complete the sale
5-sen cash rounding option for Malaysian pricing
Temporary price override at checkout without changing the saved product price
Sales history by date, with per-order item and receipt details
Receipt printing to compatible Bluetooth ESC/POS thermal printers (58 mm and 80 mm), plus reprints

faq.q: Does mPOS need an account?
faq.a: No. Everyday POS operations run without an account.

faq.q: Does it need internet?
faq.a: It is built offline-first — products, checkout and receipts work without a connection.

faq.q: Which printers are supported?
faq.a: Compatible Bluetooth ESC/POS thermal printers using 58 mm or 80 mm paper.

products.name: Sudoku - Classic Puzzle
products.tagline: Classic 9×9 Sudoku — simple, relaxing logic play.
products.intro: Fill the 9×9 grid so every row, column and 3×3 box holds 1 to 9 exactly once. Straightforward, unhurried, and easy to pick up for a few minutes or a longer session.
features: Classic 9×9 Sudoku ruleset
Simple, uncluttered interface
Relaxing pace — play a puzzle at your own speed
Suitable for beginners as well as regular Sudoku players
No account required

faq.q: Is the game free to play?
faq.a: See the Google Play listing for the current price and any in-app purchase details.

faq.q: Do I need to sign in?
faq.a: No account is required.

faq.q: Is it suitable for beginners?
faq.a: Yes — the ruleset is the standard 9×9 puzzle with a simple interface.

products.name: Block Puzzle
products.tagline: Place blocks, clear lines, beat your best score.
products.intro: A classic block puzzle: drag pieces onto the grid, fill rows and columns to clear them, and keep space open for the next move.
features: Classic block puzzle gameplay
Simple drag-and-place controls
Easy to learn, with room to plan ahead
Short sessions or longer runs
High-score chasing with a clean, simple board

faq.q: How does clearing work?
faq.a: Complete a full row or column and it clears, freeing space for the next blocks.

faq.q: Is there a time limit?
faq.a: No — you play at your own pace.

faq.q: Is the game free to play?
faq.a: See the Google Play listing for the current price and any in-app purchase details.

products.name: Number Merge
products.tagline: Merge matching numbers into bigger tiles.
products.intro: A calm number puzzle: combine matching tiles to build higher values, keep the board under control, and see how far you can get.
features: Merge matching numbers to create higher values
Simple rules that are quick to learn
Relaxing casual pace, good for short games
Clean, simple interface
Score chasing as the board grows

faq.q: How do I play?
faq.a: Combine matching numbers on the board; matching tiles merge into a higher value.

faq.q: Is there a time limit?
faq.a: No — you play at your own pace.

faq.q: Is the game free to play?
faq.a: See the Google Play listing for the current price and any in-app purchase details.
